title: Works Cited
keywords: Mirrors Windows and Sliding Glass Doors
use_cases: Use when citing historical statistics on ethnic representation in UK and US children's literature.
Use when referencing foundational theories of multicultural reader-response such as Rudine Sims Bishop's metaphors.
Use when cross-referencing industry reports from the CCBC or ALA regarding book awards and diversity.
Implement when providing academic context for the evolution of GLBTQ and BIPOC themes in YA fiction.
Configure when compiling a comprehensive bibliography for research on the sociology of children's publishing.
